channel.title: Global Wholesale Payments in 2026: ISO 20022, RTGS Renewal, and the Economics of Interoperability
channel.description: Global wholesale payments in 2026 are being reshaped by ISO 20022 harmonisation, RTGS renewal, extended settlement windows, non-bank access, API governance, DLT pilots, and cross-border payment fragmentation. The economic issue is interoperability, not messaging alone.

item.title: Global Wholesale Payments in 2026: ISO 20022, RTGS Renewal, and the Economics of Interoperability
item.description: The 2026 wholesale payments story — ISO 20022 harmonisation, RTGS renewal, operating-hours extension, interlinking, and the economics of cross-border liquidity.
